title: console shell: the page-header star and the sidebar pin become one "Pin to sidebar" action in the page overflow menu, landing in the Pinned section at the top; the app sidebar's bottom Favorites group goes
body:
Filing gate ③, a task the maintainer dispatched in person (chat, 2026-10-15, session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP`, seat account os-bill). The maintainer's words, verbatim: 「用户个人收藏，左侧菜单也有一个 pin 按钮，目前点击pin 会到顶部，但是点击右上角的收藏没有任何效果。包括这个收藏需要保留吗」, then, on the seat's proposal to merge the two into one Pinned section: 「合并为 Pinned 可以，但是这个功能常用吗？需要放在列表页右上角的明显位置吗？你的设计图我也没看到这个按钮」. The design this follows is the prototype at https://claude.ai/artifact/8JLqDFmcuK82RS1Cb8219f (private to the maintainer; the page header's ⋯ menu on the main artboard).

Blocked-by: #12423

Serial after #12423: that card rewrites the same page-header region (`PageHeader.tsx`, the header call site in `ObjectView.tsx`) and keeps the star for now; this card removes the star once #12423 has landed, so the two never edit the header in parallel.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` lane, one dev round in `@object-ui/app-shell` plus the ten `@object-ui/i18n` packs, after #12423 merges.

**Dedupe** (MCP `search_issues`, scope objectstack-ai/objectui, all states, read 2026-10-15T04:58Z): "favorites star pinned sidebar nav pin object page header" → 5 (#7044, #3631, #3999, #1055, #702, all closed; #1055 is the hover rule for the sidebar pin icon and stays in force; #3631 is the pin storage-key observation, closed); "Favorites group sidebar bottom not visible Recent" → 0, a zero read in the same run as the first query's five hits, so the channel was live. None is this card.

## The problem

The console has two personal "keep this handy" controls that write the same store and land in different places. The sidebar's pin control writes a `type: 'nav'` favorite and the item appears in the Pinned section at the top of the app navigation, which the user sees at once. The star at the top right of an object list page (and of a record page) writes a `type: 'object'` or `type: 'record'` favorite, and that appears in a Favorites group rendered after the whole navigation tree and after Recent, at the bottom of the sidebar. On an app with a long navigation the group is below the sidebar's viewport, so the star looks dead. For an object that already has a navigation item the two controls express the same wish twice, and the one with the worst feedback is the one in the page header's most prominent slot. Pinning is a once-and-forget action, not a daily one; it does not deserve that slot.

## Readings (objectui `origin/main` `fc528c3`, read 2026-10-15T04:50Z)

1. **One store, two buckets:** `packages/app-shell/src/context/FavoritesProvider.tsx` — localStorage key `objectui-favorites` scoped per user with write-through to the `UserDataAdapter` slot `ui.favorites`; `FavoriteItem.type` is one of object, dashboard, page, report, record, nav (line 56); the nav bucket and the non-nav bucket are capped separately (130–134).
2. **Sidebar pins:** `packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useNavPins.ts` 45–80 — a pin is a `type: 'nav'` favorite with `pinned: true` and id `nav:<navId>`; `NavigationRenderer` draws pinned items in the Pinned section at the top of the app navigation, in the user's order (objectui#12059).
3. **Where the star's favorite lands:** `packages/app-shell/src/layout/UnifiedSidebar.tsx` — in the app context the Favorites group (`favorites.some(f => f.type !== 'nav')`, up to 8) is rendered after the navigation tree and after Recent (the block around 565–575); the console-home sidebar has a separate Starred group for object, dashboard and page favorites (653–661).
4. **The star buttons:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` 1609 (`useFavorites`) and 3895–3915 (the header button, testid `object-favorite-btn-<object>`, id `object:<name>`); `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 572 (the record page's star).
5. **Other readers of the store:** `HomePage.tsx` 243 (the Home page's favorites); `CommandPalette.tsx` does not read favorites (it reads the app's nav items only).
6. **Measured** 2026-10-15T04:48Z, console `fc528c3` at 1440×1000 against the HotCRM demo, driven by Playwright: the star flips `aria-pressed` to true and a Favorites group appears in the sidebar DOM at y=1244 while the sidebar's scroll viewport spans y=56–1000; nothing changes in view until the sidebar is scrolled to its bottom. localStorage gains `{"id":"object:crm_lead","label":"Leads","href":"/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_lead","type":"object"}`.

## What to build

1. The star button leaves the object list header and the record page header. In its place the page's overflow menu (the ⋯ next to New and Import that #12423 keeps in the one-row header) gets one entry, "Pin to sidebar" / "Unpin from sidebar", reflecting the current state. New keys in all ten locale packs.
2. Semantics of that entry: when the current app's navigation has an item for this page's target (an `object` item with this `objectName`, or a `dashboard` / `page` item with this name), it toggles that item's pin through the existing `useNavPins().togglePin`, so the result is the Pinned section at the top, the same as the sidebar's own pin control. Otherwise (a record; an object the app does not list) it toggles the existing non-nav favorite, and that group renders directly under the Pinned section at the top of the app sidebar, never after Recent.
3. The Favorites group at the bottom of the app sidebar is removed; its content is what 2 renders at the top. The console-home sidebar's Starred group and the Home page's favorites are unchanged. The store, its keys and the adapter slot are unchanged; no migration: an existing `object:` or `record:` favorite simply renders in the new place.
4. The sidebar's hover pin control stays the primary way to pin a navigation item (objectui#1055's hover rule unchanged).

## Acceptance

- On the Leads list of an app whose navigation lists `crm_lead`, "Pin to sidebar" writes one `nav:<id>` favorite with `pinned: true` and no `object:crm_lead` favorite; the Pinned section shows Leads inside the sidebar's visible top; the entry now reads "Unpin from sidebar" and a second click removes the pin.
- On a record page, the entry writes a `record:` favorite and the group that shows it sits directly under Pinned (in the HotCRM demo at 1440×1000 its label's bounding box lies inside the sidebar's viewport without scrolling), not after Recent.
- The list header and the record header render no star button (the `object-favorite-btn-*` pins are updated deliberately, not deleted silently); `pnpm test` from the repo root green on the affected files; i18n parity green; a changeset (minor) for every published package touched.

## Out of scope

- The Home page and the console-home Starred group; the command palette reading favorites; pin ordering (objectui#12059 landed it).
- Any change to the favorites store shape or to `packages/spec`.

Attribution: written by the domain:ui seat in session `session_019YFzJp4o8Ck4NsT1toC4UP` (account os-bill) on the maintainer's instruction quoted above.
